title: NLIS Overview for Livestock Producers in Australia
reason: Explains the National Livestock Identification System and its requirements for tracking livestock.

tasks.task: Describe the National Livestock Identification System (NLIS) and its purpose.

subtasks.text: Explain what the NLIS is and why it is necessary for tracing livestock.
Mention the export of Australian red meat to over 100 markets.

tasks.task: Outline the requirements for NLIS compliance on a property.

subtasks.text: Describe the property identification code (PIC) and how to obtain it.
Explain the importance of the property's LPA accreditation and how to update it.

tasks.task: Detail the process of identifying livestock using NLIS devices.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of white breeder and orange post-breeder devices.
Emphasize the importance of placing the tags in the right ear and center.

tasks.task: Describe the requirements for selling and moving livestock using NLIS.

subtasks.text: Mention the need to fill out a national vendor declaration (NVD).
Explain that the NVD must be accurate and use the correct form version.
Describe the requirements for signatures and document copies.
